dedupe_keys.name: generalny pomiar ruchu gpr poland s general traffic census on national roads

description: The Generalny Pomiar Ruchu (GPR) is the general traffic census on Poland's national roads, run by the General Directorate for National Roads and Motorways (GDDKiA). Its main aim is to obtain, from direct counts, the basic traffic parameters for every section of the national road network, including annual average daily traffic (SDRR). Coverage: all national roads managed by GDDKiA; results pages exist for the 2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, 2020/2021 and 2025 censuses. GDDKiA states that road administrations use the results to decide on new roads and reconstruction, traffic organisation, economic indicators for investments and road classification, and that police, local governments, the statistics office and universities also use them. Format and access: results by census year on the GDDKiA pages of gov.pl, alongside traffic forecasting assumptions, capacity instructions and cost-benefit guidance. Licence and cost: free; gov.pl text is CC BY-SA 4.0, and no separate data licence was found. Caveats: five-yearly snapshots; formats vary by year and were not all opened. The census gives link volumes for calibrating national road network flow and capacity models. It relates to GDDKiA's continuous counting stations and the KPD national access point in the catalogue.
